description: This Java source file defines a Spring Boot REST controller named UserController, which manages user-related operations such as registration, deletion, email and password updates, and user retrieval. It interacts with UserService, EmailService, and handles various exceptions to provide appropriate HTTP responses.

classes.name: UserController
classes.description: Spring REST controller handling user account operations such as registration, deletion, email and password updates, and user retrieval.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Retrieves a user by their ID, throws 404 if not found.

methods.name: emailExists
methods.description: Checks if an email is registered; returns 404 if not found.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new user and sends a confirmation email; handles validation and registration exceptions.

methods.name: deleteCurrentUser
methods.description: Deletes the current user after password verification and sends a deletion email.

methods.name: updateEmail
methods.description: Updates the email of the current user after password verification.

methods.name: updatePassword
methods.description: Updates the password of the current user after verifying the current password and sends a confirmation email.
